outcome: Special Care Nursery/Neonatal Intensive Care Unit admission
finding: Women with common mental disorders were more likely to experience adverse perinatal outcomes, including induction of labor, caesarean birth, postpartum hemorrhage, and ICU admission, while their neonates were more likely to have lower Apgar scores, preterm birth, low birth weight, SCN/NICU admission, and congenital anomalies.
